verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents paying W-2 employees by same-day or next-day direct deposit and providing W-2s. For contractors, it documents creating and e-filing 1099-NEC/MISC forms and sending copies to them, which shows contractors are handled on the same platform, but the evidence never explicitly says contractors can be paid through it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of contractor payments (e.g., contractor direct deposit), evidence that both worker types are paid in a single unified run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: run payroll by 7:00 am to pay your employees that same business day
Your team can access their pay stubs and W-2s
Create and e-file unlimited 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC form with the IRS** We’ll automatically send copies to your contractors.
